relationships.subject: Genicular artery embolization
relationships.evidence_quote: There was a statistically significant decrease in the serum levels of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and interleukin-1 receptor antagonist (IL-1Ra) at 12 months.

relationships.subject: Genicular artery embolization
relationships.evidence_quote: The observed reductions in serum VEGF and IL-1Ra levels following GAE may contribute to local pain relief and decreased inflammation in the knee joints.

relationships.subject: Genicular artery embolization
relationships.evidence_quote: GAE is a safe treatment for symptomatic KOA, providing clinically significant pain relief for a subset of patients.

key_findings: GAE gave 62% clinical success at 12 months with no severe adverse events
Serum VEGF and IL-1Ra decreased significantly at 12 months
